Bea (docs): Pushed a draft PR for an HSM key-rotation section in the onprem migration guide. It covers rolling keys, SDK snippets, and a short troubleshooting table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1487 :memo:
Luca (eng-runtime): Nice. Can you include the minimal SDK snippet for key alias switch and a note about PKCS#11 module reload? Customers get confused during zero-downtime rotations.
Bea (docs): Added a small SDK example and a systemd hint. Snippet (copy-paste friendly):
```
# SDK: rotate key alias (python pseudocode)
from redwood_sdk import KMSClient
kms = KMSClient(endpoint="https://<kms-fqdn>")
kms.create_key_alias(old_alias="redwood-prod", new_key_id="key-abcdef")
kms.switch_alias(alias="redwood-prod", target_key_id="key-abcdef")
# trigger local agent config reload (systemd)
sudo systemctl reload redwood-agent
```
Anya (security): Add an explicit line that customers must seed the HSM ACLs for the new key and that some HSMs require vendor-managed PIN reload. Also mention PKCS#11 session invalidation and recommend restarting the agent if sessions persist.
Bea (docs): Incorporated: prose note about ACLs/PIN and a short one-liner: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/<pkcs11-module>.so -R` to list slots. Kept the code block minimal.
Sam (support): Can we add expected error messages and quick fixes? E.g., "CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID" -> restart agent or bounce PKCS#11 process; "permission denied" -> check HSM ACL entry. Reduces tickets.
Bea (docs): Added a troubleshooting mini-table under the snippet with those two entries and remediation steps. Also fixed a broken anchor to the migration checklist that lint flagged.
Luca (eng-runtime): Also include a TLS healthcheck and cert verify for KMS after rotation: `curl -I --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://<kms-fqdn>/health` and `openssl s_client -connect <kms-fqdn>:443 -servername <kms-fqdn> </dev/null` — put these in prose as one-liners.
Bea (docs): Added both one-liners and a short note about updating `--ca-bundle-path` in air-gapped installs.
Anya (security): LGTM, tiny wording nit: change "restart agent" to "graceful restart of agent to reinitialize PKCS#11 session".
Bea (docs): Updated wording. Ran doc-lint, fixed a link to the HSM vendor appendix and replaced concrete hostnames with placeholders.
installer-bot: docs staging build succeeded (2026-03-27-1100) :white_check_mark:
Sam (support): I'll add a KB entry that mirrors the troubleshooting lines and link to the PR once merged. Keeps support responses consistent.
Bea (docs): Thanks all  I'll mark PR ready for review and ping eng-runtime & security for final sign-off. Closing after merge.
